derived_feature_rule: previous_score_avg = rolling mean of (previous_score, previous_score_2) with single-score fallback to previous_score; score_trend = previous_score - previous_score_2 (0.0 if previous_score_2 is missing).
threshold_optimization_rationale: Threshold 0.18 was selected strictly on the validation selection fold (N=1250) to maximize F2 safety-net score (0.820) subject to precision >= 0.55. It achieved 90.8% recall, 59.1% precision, and 85.2% specificity.
selection_rationale: XGBoost was selected programmatically as champion via composite validation score (0.8818 = 0.35*MeanAP + 0.25*MeanROCAUC + 0.25*ValOptF2 + 0.15*(1-MeanBrier)) over non-dummy candidates evaluated exclusively on validation selection folds (Temp AP=0.852, Disjoint AP=0.860, Mean Brier=0.0701).

LOW_RISK.label: Low Risk
LOW_RISK.description: Student trajectory suggests strong likelihood of reaching assessment benchmarks (>= 40). Continue standard classroom engagement.

MODERATE_RISK.label: Moderate Risk
MODERATE_RISK.description: Student trajectory demonstrates emerging instability (e.g., lower assignment completion or declining trend). Recommend light teacher check-in.

HIGH_RISK.label: High Risk / Priority Advisory
HIGH_RISK.description: Student trajectory indicates elevated risk of scoring below 40. Timely teacher review, mentoring check-in, or study support recommended.
